name: Garments, Uniforms & Workwear
intro: Plan clothing orders for your team, workplace, event or resale requirements. Share the garment type, fabric preference, size breakdown and quantity so we can review suitable options for your order.
prompt: Tell us the fabric or GSM requirement, colour, quantity by size, branding positions and required delivery date.

name: Bags & Backpacks
intro: Explore bag requirements for workplaces, schools, events and promotional use. Send your preferred style, dimensions, material and quantity, with artwork or a reference image if you have one.
prompt: Include bag dimensions, material, handle type, compartments, print position and quantity.

name: Stationery & Office Supplies
intro: Put together the everyday items your office, institution or project needs. Send a list of stationery products and quantities so the required brands, specifications and pack sizes can be reviewed together.
prompt: Include item name, preferred brand, size or specification, pack quantity and total units.

name: Paper & Printing Materials
intro: Plan paper purchases and printed materials for your organisation, campaign or project. Share the finished size, paper specification, printing requirements and quantity so your request can be reviewed accurately.
prompt: Include page count, paper GSM, paper type, colour or black-and-white printing, binding, finishing and quantity. Attach the print file or a reference when available.

name: Corporate Gifts & Promotional Items
intro: Plan products for staff gifts, business events and brand campaigns. Tell us your audience, item preferences, quantity and branding requirements so suitable options can be considered for your request.
prompt: Include your quantity, budget range if useful, artwork, packaging preference and event date.

name: Packaging Materials
intro: Find packaging options suited to your product and handling needs. Share dimensions, material preferences, quantities and any printing requirements so the packaging specification can be reviewed before quoting.
prompt: Include internal dimensions, intended contents, material or thickness requirement, printing and pack quantities.
